class Point {
  constructor(public x: number) {}
}
interface Point {
  label?: string;
}
const p = new Point(1);
p.label = "a";
console.log(p.x, p.label);

interface Box<T> {
  tag?: T;
}
class Box<T> {
  constructor(public value: T) {}
}
const box = new Box(1);
box.tag = 2;
const tag: number | undefined = box.tag;
console.log(box.value, tag);

interface Named {
  name: string;
}
class Pet {
  constructor(name: string) {
    this.name = name;
  }
}
interface Pet extends Named {
  describe?(): string;
}
const pet: Pet = new Pet("Tama");
pet.describe = () => `pet ${pet.name}`;
console.log(pet.describe?.());
const plain: Point = { x: 2 };
console.log(plain.x);
class Greeter {
  greet(): string {
    return "hi";
  }
}
interface Greeter {
  greet(name: string): string;
}
Greeter.prototype.greet = function (name?: string) {
  return name ? `hi ${name}` : "hi";
};
console.log(new Greeter().greet(), new Greeter().greet("Ann"));
